<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_UniversityEnrollment" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/university-enrollment">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_UniversityEnrollment" name="University Enrollment" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Main">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Student" name="Prospective / Enrolled Student">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_Applicant</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SubmitApplication</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ProvideMissingDocs</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ConfirmEnrollment</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_InternationalDecision</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_InternationalMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ObtainStudentID</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>SubProcess_StudyPlan</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_SemesterMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_AttendClasses</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_AddDropDecision</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_AddDropCourses</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_AddDropMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReviewGrades</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_GrievanceDecision</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>SubProcess_Appeal</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_AppealMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_NextSemesterDecision</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_Graduated</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_Withdrawn</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Admissions" name="Admissions Office">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_DocsMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReviewDocuments</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_DocsComplete</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_NotifyMissingDocs</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ParallelEvalSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ParallelEvalJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendAcceptance</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendRejection</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_Rejected</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ConfirmedDecision</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CancelApplication</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_Canceled</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ParallelConfirmSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ParallelConfirmJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Committee" name="Admissions Committee">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EvaluateApplication</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_AcceptanceDecision</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Finance" name="Finance Department">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ProcessFees</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_IT" name="IT Department">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SetupAccounts</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_International" name="International Student Office">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_VisaProcessing</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_UniversityAdmin" name="University Administration">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendOrientation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PostGrades</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <!-- Application and document review -->
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Applicant" name="Application process started">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_01</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SubmitApplication" name="Submit online application">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_01</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_02</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_DocsMerge" name="Documents review merge">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_02</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_08</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_03</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ReviewDocuments" name="Review application and supporting documents">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_03</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_04</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_DocsComplete" name="Documents missing?" default="Flow_06">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_04</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_05</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_06</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_NotifyMissingDocs" name="Notify applicant of missing documents">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_05</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_07</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ProvideMissingDocs" name="Provide missing items">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_07</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_08</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <!-- Concurrent evaluation and fee processing -->
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ParallelEvalSplit" name="Start evaluation and fee processing">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_06</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_09</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_10</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EvaluateApplication" name="Evaluate application">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_09</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_11</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ProcessFees" name="Process application fees or waivers">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_10</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_12</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ParallelEvalJoin" name="Evaluation and fees complete">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_11</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_12</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_13</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <!-- Admission decision -->
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AcceptanceDecision" name="Application accepted?" default="Flow_15">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_13</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_14</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_15</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendAcceptance" name="Send acceptance letter">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_14</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_17</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendRejection" name="Send rejection letter">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_15</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_16</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Rejected" name="Application rejected">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_16</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <!-- Enrollment confirmation -->
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ConfirmEnrollment" name="Confirm enrollment by deadline">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_17</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_18</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ConfirmedDecision" name="Enrollment confirmed by deadline?" default="Flow_19">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_18</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_19</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_20</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_CancelApplication" name="Cancel application">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_19</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_21</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Canceled" name="Application canceled">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_21</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ParallelConfirmSplit" name="Start orientation and account setup">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_20</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_22</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_23</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendOrientation" name="Send orientation materials">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_22</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_24</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_SetupAccounts" name="Set up student accounts (email, online portals, library access)">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_23</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_25</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ParallelConfirmJoin" name="Orientation and accounts complete">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_24</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_25</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_26</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <!-- International students -->
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_InternationalDecision" name="International student?" default="Flow_28">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_26</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_27</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_28</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_VisaProcessing" name="Assist with visa processing">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_27</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_29</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_InternationalMerge" name="International check merge">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_28</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_29</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_30</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ObtainStudentID" name="Obtain student ID card">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_30</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_31</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <!-- Study plan -->
    <bpmn:subProcess id="SubProcess_StudyPlan" name="Create study plan">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_31</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_32</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_StudyPlan">
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SP_01</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:startEvent>
      <bpmn:userTask id="Task_MeetAdvisor" name="Meet with academic advisor">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SP_01</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SP_02</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:userTask>
      <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SelectCourses" name="Select courses">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SP_02</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SP_03</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:userTask>
      <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ResolveConflicts" name="Resolve schedule conflicts">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SP_03</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SP_04</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:userTask>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_StudyPlan">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SP_04</bpmn:incoming>
      </bpmn:endEvent>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SP_01" sourceRef="StartEvent_StudyPlan" targetRef="Task_MeetAdvisor"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SP_02" sourceRef="Task_MeetAdvisor" targetRef="Task_SelectCourses"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SP_03" sourceRef="Task_SelectCourses" targetRef="Task_ResolveConflicts"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SP_04" sourceRef="Task_ResolveConflicts" targetRef="EndEvent_StudyPlan"/>
    </bpmn:subProcess>

    <!-- Semester loop -->
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_SemesterMerge" name="Semester start">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_32</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NextSemester</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_33</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_AttendClasses" name="Attend classes">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_33</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_34</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AddDropDecision" name="Add or drop courses?" default="Flow_36">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_34</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_35</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_36</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_AddDropCourses" name="Add or drop courses within add/drop period">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_35</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_37</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AddDropMerge" name="Add/drop complete">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_36</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_37</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_38</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_PostGrades" name="Post grades at end of semester">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_38</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_39</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ReviewGrades" name="Review grades online">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_39</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_40</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_GrievanceDecision" name="Grievance to file?" default="Flow_42">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_40</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_41</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_42</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <!-- Appeal -->
    <bpmn:subProcess id="SubProcess_Appeal" name="File and process appeal">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_41</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_43</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Appeal">
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AP_01</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:startEvent>
      <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SubmitAppealForm" name="Submit appeal form">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AP_01</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AP_02</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:userTask>
      <bpmn:userTask id="Task_MeetAppealsCommittee" name="Meet with appeals committee">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AP_02</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AP_03</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:userTask>
      <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_AwaitAppealDecision" name="Appeal decision received">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AP_03</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AP_04</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Appeal">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AP_04</bpmn:incoming>
      </bpmn:endEvent>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AP_01" sourceRef="StartEvent_Appeal" targetRef="Task_SubmitAppealForm"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AP_02" sourceRef="Task_SubmitAppealForm" targetRef="Task_MeetAppealsCommittee"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AP_03" sourceRef="Task_MeetAppealsCommittee" targetRef="Event_AwaitAppealDecision"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AP_04" sourceRef="Event_AwaitAppealDecision" targetRef="EndEvent_Appeal"/>
    </bpmn:subProcess>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AppealMerge" name="Appeal handling complete">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_42</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_43</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_44</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <!-- Next semester, graduation or withdrawal -->
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_NextSemesterDecision" name="Continue, graduate or withdraw?" default="Flow_NextSemester">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_44</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NextSemester</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Graduates</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Withdraws</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Graduated" name="Student graduated">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Graduates</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Withdrawn" name="Student withdrew">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Withdraws</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <!-- Sequence flows -->
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_01" sourceRef="StartEvent_Applicant" targetRef="Task_SubmitApplication"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_02" sourceRef="Task_SubmitApplication" targetRef="Gateway_DocsMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_03" sourceRef="Gateway_DocsMerge" targetRef="Task_ReviewDocuments"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_04" sourceRef="Task_ReviewDocuments" targetRef="Gateway_DocsComplete"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_05" name="Documents missing" sourceRef="Gateway_DocsComplete" targetRef="Task_NotifyMissingDocs">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${documentsMissing}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_06" name="All documents received" sourceRef="Gateway_DocsComplete" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelEvalSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_07" sourceRef="Task_NotifyMissingDocs" targetRef="Task_ProvideMissingDocs"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_08" sourceRef="Task_ProvideMissingDocs" targetRef="Gateway_DocsMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_09" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelEvalSplit" targetRef="Task_EvaluateApplication"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelEvalSplit" targetRef="Task_ProcessFees"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Task_EvaluateApplication" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelEvalJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Task_ProcessFees" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelEvalJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelEvalJoin" targetRef="Gateway_AcceptanceDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" name="Accepted" sourceRef="Gateway_AcceptanceDecision" targetRef="Task_SendAcceptance">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${applicationAccepted}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15" name="Rejected" sourceRef="Gateway_AcceptanceDecision" targetRef="Task_SendRejection"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_16" sourceRef="Task_SendRejection" targetRef="EndEvent_Rejected"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_17" sourceRef="Task_SendAcceptance" targetRef="Task_ConfirmEnrollment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_18" sourceRef="Task_ConfirmEnrollment" targetRef="Gateway_ConfirmedDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_19" name="Not confirmed by deadline" sourceRef="Gateway_ConfirmedDecision" targetRef="Task_CancelApplication"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_20" name="Confirmed" sourceRef="Gateway_ConfirmedDecision" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelConfirmSplit">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${enrollmentConfirmed}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_21" sourceRef="Task_CancelApplication" targetRef="EndEvent_Canceled"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_22" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelConfirmSplit" targetRef="Task_SendOrientation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_23" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelConfirmSplit" targetRef="Task_SetupAccounts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_24" sourceRef="Task_SendOrientation" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelConfirmJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_25" sourceRef="Task_SetupAccounts" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelConfirmJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_26" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelConfirmJoin" targetRef="Gateway_InternationalDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_27" name="International" sourceRef="Gateway_InternationalDecision" targetRef="Task_VisaProcessing">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${isInternational}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_28" name="Domestic" sourceRef="Gateway_InternationalDecision" targetRef="Gateway_InternationalMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_29" sourceRef="Task_VisaProcessing" targetRef="Gateway_InternationalMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_30" sourceRef="Gateway_InternationalMerge" targetRef="Task_ObtainStudentID"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_31" sourceRef="Task_ObtainStudentID" targetRef="SubProcess_StudyPlan"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_32" sourceRef="SubProcess_StudyPlan" targetRef="Gateway_SemesterMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_33" sourceRef="Gateway_SemesterMerge" targetRef="Task_AttendClasses"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_34" sourceRef="Task_AttendClasses" targetRef="Gateway_AddDropDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_35" name="Add or drop" sourceRef="Gateway_AddDropDecision" targetRef="Task_AddDropCourses">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${addDropRequested}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_36" name="No changes" sourceRef="Gateway_AddDropDecision" targetRef="Gateway_AddDropMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_37" sourceRef="Task_AddDropCourses" targetRef="Gateway_AddDropMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_38" sourceRef="Gateway_AddDropMerge" targetRef="Task_PostGrades"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_39" sourceRef="Task_PostGrades" targetRef="Task_ReviewGrades"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_40" sourceRef="Task_ReviewGrades" targetRef="Gateway_GrievanceDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_41" name="Grievance" sourceRef="Gateway_GrievanceDecision" targetRef="SubProcess_Appeal">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${grievanceFiled}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_42" name="No grievance" sourceRef="Gateway_GrievanceDecision" targetRef="Gateway_AppealMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_43" sourceRef="SubProcess_Appeal" targetRef="Gateway_AppealMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_44" sourceRef="Gateway_AppealMerge" targetRef="Gateway_NextSemesterDecision"/>

<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_UniversityEnrollment" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/university-enrollment">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_UniversityEnrollment" name="University Enrollment" isExecutable="false">

    <!-- Application and document review -->
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Applicant" name="Application process started"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SubmitApplication" name="Submit online application"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_DocsMerge" name="Documents review merge"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ReviewDocuments" name="Review application and supporting documents"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_DocsComplete" name="Documents missing?" default="Flow_06"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_NotifyMissingDocs" name="Notify applicant of missing documents"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ProvideMissingDocs" name="Provide missing items"/>

    <!-- Concurrent evaluation and fee processing -->
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ParallelEvalSplit" name="Start evaluation and fee processing"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EvaluateApplication" name="Evaluate application"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ProcessFees" name="Process application fees or waivers"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ParallelEvalJoin" name="Evaluation and fees complete"/>

    <!-- Admission decision -->
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AcceptanceDecision" name="Application accepted?" default="Flow_15"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendAcceptance" name="Send acceptance letter"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendRejection" name="Send rejection letter"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Rejected" name="Application rejected"/>

    <!-- Enrollment confirmation -->
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ConfirmEnrollment" name="Confirm enrollment by deadline"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ConfirmedDecision" name="Enrollment confirmed by deadline?" default="Flow_19"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_CancelApplication" name="Cancel application"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Canceled" name="Application canceled"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ParallelConfirmSplit" name="Start orientation and account setup"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendOrientation" name="Send orientation materials"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_SetupAccounts" name="Set up student accounts (email, online portals, library access)"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ParallelConfirmJoin" name="Orientation and accounts complete"/>

    <!-- International students -->
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_InternationalDecision" name="International student?" default="Flow_28"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_VisaProcessing" name="Assist with visa processing"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_InternationalMerge" name="International check merge"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ObtainStudentID" name="Obtain student ID card"/>

    <!-- Study plan -->
    <bpmn:subProcess id="SubProcess_StudyPlan" name="Create study plan">
      <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_StudyPlan"/>
      <bpmn:userTask id="Task_MeetAdvisor" name="Meet with academic advisor"/>
      <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SelectCourses" name="Select courses"/>
      <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ResolveConflicts" name="Resolve schedule conflicts"/>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_StudyPlan"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SP_01" sourceRef="StartEvent_StudyPlan" targetRef="Task_MeetAdvisor"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SP_02" sourceRef="Task_MeetAdvisor" targetRef="Task_SelectCourses"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SP_03" sourceRef="Task_SelectCourses" targetRef="Task_ResolveConflicts"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SP_04" sourceRef="Task_ResolveConflicts" targetRef="EndEvent_StudyPlan"/>
    </bpmn:subProcess>

    <!-- Semester cycle -->
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_SemesterMerge" name="Semester start"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_AttendClasses" name="Attend classes"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AddDropDecision" name="Add or drop courses?" default="Flow_36"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_AddDropCourses" name="Add or drop courses within add/drop period"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AddDropMerge" name="Add/drop complete"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PostGrades" name="Post grades at end of semester"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ReviewGrades" name="Review grades online"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_GrievanceDecision" name="Grievance to file?" default="Flow_42"/>

    <!-- Appeal -->
    <bpmn:subProcess id="SubProcess_Appeal" name="File and process appeal">
      <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Appeal"/>

      <bpmn:userTask id="Task_MeetAppealsCommittee" name="Meet with appeals committee"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_AwaitAppealDecision" name="Await decision"/>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Appeal"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AP_01" sourceRef="StartEvent_Appeal" targetRef="Task_SubmitAppealForm"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AP_02" sourceRef="Task_SubmitAppealForm" targetRef="Task_MeetAppealsCommittee"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AP_03" sourceRef="Task_MeetAppealsCommittee" targetRef="Task_AwaitAppealDecision"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AP_04" sourceRef="Task_AwaitAppealDecision" targetRef="EndEvent_Appeal"/>
    </bpmn:subProcess>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AppealMerge" name="Appeal handling complete"/>

    <!-- Continue, graduate or withdraw -->
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_NextSemesterDecision" name="Continue, graduate or withdraw?" default="Flow_45"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RecordGraduation" name="Record graduation"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Graduated" name="Student graduated"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProcessWithdrawal" name="Process withdrawal"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Withdrawn" name="Student withdrew"/>

    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_06" name="All documents received" sourceRef="Gateway_DocsComplete" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelEvalSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_07" sourceRef="Task_NotifyMissingDocs" targetRef="Task_ProvideMissingDocs"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_08" sourceRef="Task_ProvideMissingDocs" targetRef="Gateway_DocsMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_09" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelEvalSplit" targetRef="Task_EvaluateApplication"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelEvalSplit" targetRef="Task_ProcessFees"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Task_EvaluateApplication" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelEvalJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Task_ProcessFees" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelEvalJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelEvalJoin" targetRef="Gateway_AcceptanceDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" name="Accepted" sourceRef="Gateway_AcceptanceDecision" targetRef="Task_SendAcceptance">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${applicationAccepted}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15" name="Rejected" sourceRef="Gateway_AcceptanceDecision" targetRef="Task_SendRejection"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_16" sourceRef="Task_SendRejection" targetRef="EndEvent_Rejected"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_17" sourceRef="Task_SendAcceptance" targetRef="Task_ConfirmEnrollment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_18" sourceRef="Task_ConfirmEnrollment" targetRef="Gateway_ConfirmedDecision"/>

    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_21" sourceRef="Task_CancelApplication" targetRef="EndEvent_Canceled"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_22" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelConfirmSplit" targetRef="Task_SendOrientation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_23" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelConfirmSplit" targetRef="Task_SetupAccounts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_24" sourceRef="Task_SendOrientation" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelConfirmJoin"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_28" name="Domestic" sourceRef="Gateway_InternationalDecision" targetRef="Gateway_InternationalMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_29" sourceRef="Task_VisaProcessing" targetRef="Gateway_InternationalMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_30" sourceRef="Gateway_InternationalMerge" targetRef="Task_ObtainStudentID"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_31" sourceRef="Task_ObtainStudentID" targetRef="SubProcess_StudyPlan"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_32" sourceRef="SubProcess_StudyPlan" targetRef="Gateway_SemesterMerge"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_34" sourceRef="Task_AttendClasses" targetRef="Gateway_AddDropDecision"/>

      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${addDropRequested}</bpmn:conditionExpression>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_37" sourceRef="Task_AddDropCourses" targetRef="Gateway_AddDropMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_38" sourceRef="Gateway_AddDropMerge" targetRef="Task_PostGrades"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_39" sourceRef="Task_PostGrades" targetRef="Task_ReviewGrades"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_41" name="Grievance" sourceRef="Gateway_GrievanceDecision" targetRef="SubProcess_Appeal">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${grievanceFiled}</bpmn:conditionExpression>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_46" name="Graduates" sourceRef="Gateway_NextSemesterDecision" targetRef="Task_RecordGraduation">

rules.instruction: When the description states that one activity is followed by two or more separate actions that all must happen, with no order stated between them, and the process continues only after all of them are done: Model a parallel gateway that splits the flow after the preceding activity into one branch per action, with each action as its own task. Close the branches with a parallel gateway before the next activity that needs all of them. Also place a parallel gateway around any activity the description lists as a separate, unordered step within such a group, so that each stated step keeps its own position in the flow. Do not use an exclusive gateway for branches that must all complete.
rules.situation: the description states that one event, such as a party confirming or accepting something, is followed by two or more separate actions performed by different actors or systems, with no order stated between them, and a later step depends on all of them being done

rules.instruction: When the description lists a step of waiting for an outcome as one ordered step in a sequence and names no message, signal, timer or condition for that wait: Model that waiting step as a task placed in the sequence at its stated position. Use an intermediate catch event only where the description names a message, signal, timer or condition that the process waits for.
rules.situation: the description lists a step of waiting for an outcome as one ordered step in a sequence and names no message, signal, timer or condition for that wait

rules.instruction: When the description says a repeated cycle continues until the participant reaches one of several stated end outcomes, for example one outcome that ends the cycle by completing and another that ends it by leaving: Place a decision gateway at the end of the repeated cycle. Give it a loop-back branch to the start of the cycle for the continuing case, and a separate outgoing branch for each stated exit outcome. Model each exit outcome as its own activity on its branch, and do not let the exit branches merge back into the cycle.
